units.source_text: “咱们家本来就不需要你爹画什么画稿嘛。

en.t: Our family never really needed your father to draw any designs in the first place.

units.source_text: 只要鉴别别人染好送来的东西，能卖出去就行。

en.t: As long as we can judge the things other people have dyed and brought in, and sell them, that is enough.
But your father is always...,” Mother said.
